applicable_rules.description: For this case, the oral dose must be 10 to 15 mg/kg per administration, inclusive.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the oral acetaminophen order in this case.

applicable_rules.description: For this case, a single administration must not exceed 15 mg/kg.
applicability_conditions: Applies to each scheduled acetaminophen administration.

applicable_rules.description: For this case, the total scheduled dose must not exceed 60 mg/kg in any 24-hour period.
applicability_conditions: Applies to the scheduled order over a 24-hour period.

constraint_checks.rationale: 120 mg divided by 12 kg is 10 mg/kg/dose, within the inclusive 10–15 mg/kg/dose range.
The calculated single dose is 10 mg/kg, below the 15 mg/kg maximum.
Every 6 hours corresponds to 4 scheduled doses per 24 hours: 120 mg × 4 ÷ 12 kg = 40 mg/kg/day, below the 60 mg/kg/day maximum.
